items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And also I played the Sun Dodgers. That was with them. ... His last name was Coim. His last name was Coyne.

ctx.x: What did Johnny play? He played drums and trumpet. And I heard Pinky played trumpet. Yeah. And I never heard him.

He played with the guitar. He was good. He was really good. A fine musician. In fact, sometimes he put the Shriners band. He does arranging and all for him. I think sometimes he leads the band at the Shriners at the Jerusalem Temple. Oh yeah. I guess when Mike Kaplan does it, he does it. I don't know if Mike does. Yeah. Yeah. And also I played the Sun Dodgers. That was with them. His name was Dan Mays on the sax. Show Duty on the drums. There was the chorus on the guitar and the piano man. His last name was Coim.…
He quit playing a long time ago. You're going to pull a lot of names I never heard of.
